name: GetProspect
summary: B2B people and company search and enrichment, work email finding and email verification.

api_key.description: A GetProspect API key (Settings > API); it spends its workspace's credits. Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: Searching is free; emails spend email credits and verifications spend the USD wallet, only when something is found. 402 with X-Limit-Reached when the balance is out.
Saving people or companies, lists, bulk jobs, exports, webhooks, phone reveals and the block list are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get credit balances
endpoints.summary: Live balance of each credit type (email_search, email_verification, phone_search) and the USD wallet.

endpoints.name: Search people
endpoints.summary: People by name, location, title, seniority, department and company filters, with email and phone availability.

filters.description: Filters, ANDed, at least one include: person_job_title {include, match_mode}, person_location, person_seniority, person_department, company {name|domain: {include}}, company_industry, company_headcount_range, max_person_per_company, ...

enrich_email.description: Reveal each result's email for 1 email credit per email revealed; per_page must then be 25.

notes: A read over POST: searching is free; only enrich_email spends credits.
Allowed values of the closed filters come from getprospect.reference.enum; open ones from getprospect.reference.suggest.

endpoints.name: Count people matching filters
endpoints.summary: How many people a people-search filter set matches, optionally broken down by country, department and seniority.

group_by.description: Up to three of country, department, seniority.

pivot.description: One row per combination of the group_by values.

country_limit.description: How many countries to return, largest first.

notes: A read over POST. Free; answers can come from a cache up to an hour old (metadata.counted_at).

endpoints.name: Enrich a person
endpoints.summary: Full profile of one person (identity, location, work history) with a verified business email, by id, LinkedIn URL, email, or name and company.

data.description: One of: id, linkedin_id, linkedin_url, email, or first_name + last_name + company_domain (or company_name).

enrich_email.description: Reveal a verified business email (default true); false skips it and its cost.

notes: A read over POST. 1 email credit per newly revealed email; nothing when no one matches (200 with NOT_FOUND in errors).

A first email search can run past call_vendor's 60-second timeout. A slow one may instead answer the email as searching with retry_after, free: it runs on, and asking again after that many seconds serves (and charges) the address. A 408 is free too; ask again in a few minutes.

endpoints.name: Enrich a company
endpoints.summary: Full profile of one company: industry, headcount, locations, domains and LinkedIn data.

data.description: One of: id, linkedin_id, linkedin_url, domain, or name.

notes: A read over POST. Free; no match is 200 with data null and NOT_FOUND in errors.

endpoints.name: Search companies
endpoints.summary: Companies by name, domain, industry, location, headcount, founding year, type and keywords.

filters.description: Filters, ANDed, at least one include: company {name|domain: {include}}, company_industry, company_country, company_headcount_range, company_keywords, ...

sort_by.description: Sort key, e.g. company_employee_count; default relevance with keywords, else followers.

endpoints.name: Find a work email
endpoints.summary: The verified business email of a person from their name and company.

data.description: The person: full_name, or first_name + last_name; plus domain (best results) or company (a name, used when no domain).

notes: A read over POST: the person goes in a data object. 1 email credit per address served that the workspace did not already own; not found and accept-all are free.
A live search can run past call_vendor's 60-second timeout. One that times out at GetProspect answers 408, free; ask again after Retry-After seconds, when its result is usually stored.

endpoints.name: Verify an email
endpoints.summary: Deliverability verdict for one address, with domain health and free or disposable flags.
notes: A read over POST: the address goes in a data object. Charged once per address per workspace for a valid, invalid or accept_all verdict: $0.0008 from the USD wallet per the credits page (the endpoint reference calls it 1 email verification credit); unknown verdicts and malformed addresses are free.
Verification can take up to 75 seconds, so it can run past call_vendor's 60-second timeout. A 408 is free; ask again after Retry-After seconds.

endpoints.name: Suggest filter values
endpoints.summary: Typeahead values for locations, job titles, industries, keywords, technologies, people or companies, to pass to the search filters.

endpoints.name: Get a filter's allowed values
endpoints.summary: The accepted values of a closed filter vocabulary.
notes: Free, needs no key, cached for an hour.
